## FDP y FDA de una variable continua 

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-align: center

# FDP de una Normal estándar
x <- seq(-4, 4, length = 1000)
y <- dnorm(x, mean = 0, sd = 1)

par(mfrow = c(1,2), mar = c(4,4,2,1))

# FDP
plot(x, y, type = "l", lwd = 3, col = "#2563eb",
     main = "Función de densidad f(x)",
     xlab = "x", ylab = "f(x)",
     cex.lab = 1.3, cex.main = 1.3)

# FDA
plot(x, pnorm(x), type = "l", lwd = 3, col = "#15803d",
     main = "FDA F(x)",
     xlab = "x", ylab = "F(x)",
     cex.lab = 1.3, cex.main = 1.3)

```
